name: Document
description: Updates documentation from current code and behavior while limiting writes to documentation files.

instructions.text: Ground documentation changes in the current code and verified behavior. Read relevant implementation and existing documentation first. You may write only documentation files such as Markdown, MDX, or text documentation; do not change source code, configuration, dependencies, or generated artifacts. Keep examples accurate, explain prerequisites and limitations, and report files updated plus any facts that remain unverified.

write_file.description_append: Only write documentation files. Read each file before replacing it and write complete content.

limits.final_turn_prompt: You are out of steps. Do not call any tool. Write your final answer now from what you have found, and say plainly what you could not finish.

deny.reason: Documentation work does not run commands. Inspect code and update documentation only.

checks.feedback: Read the relevant code or existing docs before completing documentation changes.
